lower_layer.negative: Every foreign-root omitted cell refuses as usage with zero stdout and the undecidable-scope reason.

guarantees.simultaneous_or_coalesced_exit: Two current-generation provider exits converge in either event order and when one controller lease coalesces both events.
guarantees.exact_generation_cleanup: Every exact generation loses both its Registry Pane and retained pane_dead/mirrored runtime Pane.
guarantees.offline_resumable_refs: Each Agent is Offline with paneRef cleared while its conversation sessionRef remains resumable.
guarantees.sibling_preservation: The live sibling shell and unrelated failed Agent remain byte/identity stable.
guarantees.fixed_point: Repeating the same exits and convergence writes zero transactions and leaves Registry bytes identical.

guarantees.foreground_producer_matrix: The closed generated pane-menu, Window, direct Agent Pane, popup, statusbar, hook, and runtime producer catalog has no unclassified foreground route.
guarantees.exact_client_delivery: Mutation success and refusal/failure feedback reaches only one bounded display-message on the exact invoking client.
guarantees.success_silent_no_overlay: Successful silent routes emit zero foreground bytes and every route leaves pane_in_mode=0 with no view-mode overlay.
guarantees.origin_identity_preservation: The origin Pane PID/current command, exact client focus, and Registry Pane UID survive the entire matrix.
guarantees.bounded_refusal_failure: Refused and undeliverable routes remain bounded, typed, visible, and never leak raw stdout/stderr or a returned-N overlay.

guarantees.fixed_point: Event carry across the worker lease converges, and replay after closure leaves Registry bytes and the zero-Window root unchanged.

guarantees.control_root_retention: The exact ControlSession uid/root remains registered after its final Window disappears.
guarantees.zero_replacement_allocation: Automatic closure allocates no replacement Window, Pane, Agent, or uid and does not borrow Project pin authority.
guarantees.sibling_containment: The same-socket Project and foreign runtime sibling survive with the queried socket contained below the owned smoke root.
